citations.description: Ticket comment 'PRE-REMEDIATION BASELINE' provides a per-file census of 26 diagnostics but no per-diagnostic disposition; completion comment states only aggregate 'mypy src/rebar --warn-unused-ignores exit 0'.

findings.criterion: [operator-attested] A ticket comment maps each live warn_unused_ignores diagnostic (measured against current origin/main) to removed, preserved-and-narrowed, or preserved-and-documented.
findings.detail: The operator-attested evidence does not substantively satisfy the criterion. The 'PRE-REMEDIATION BASELINE' comment provides only a per-file CENSUS (an enumeration of the 26 diagnostics across 22 files) — it does not map each diagnostic to one of the three required dispositions (removed / preserved-and-narrowed / preserved-and-documented). The completion comment merely asserts the aggregate outcome 'mypy src/rebar --warn-unused-ignores exit 0' with no per-diagnostic disposition. Yet the code shows some ignores were in fact PRESERVED (e.g. src/rebar/llm/workflow/schema.py:83 retains '# type: ignore[name-defined]' with a documenting comment; several ignores remain in src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/), so a mapping distinguishing removed vs preserved entries is genuinely required and is absent. An enumeration is not the required disposition mapping.
findings.remediation: Record a ticket comment that, for each of the ~26 live warn_unused_ignores diagnostics measured against current origin/main (SHA 1767d9e401 or the landed base), states explicitly whether it was removed, preserved-and-narrowed, or preserved-and-documented — naming the file:line and the reason for each preserved entry.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
